description: groundhog is a Python package of documented geotechnical calculations for onshore and offshore problems. Its functions cover soil and foundation design tasks and include parameter checks and unit tests. An analyst supplies measured soil properties, geometry and design parameters, then receives calculation results for the selected foundation or geotechnical condition. The package is not a regional geology dataset; its spatial scope is the site whose inputs are supplied. The README gives package documentation and installation information, and GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 terms. A limitation is that formula outputs inherit the uncertainty of field measurements and chosen empirical assumptions, especially where ground conditions vary. Groundhog can help set foundation or ground-failure parameters for infrastructure hazard simulations. The related catalogue OpenSees model is a structural solver; it does not provide the same geotechnical calculation library. No soil data or Python package was downloaded or executed.
